Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated distribution relationships with ownership, incorrectly inferring that Apple Records is part of Universal Music Group due to EMI/UMG distribution history. This misattribution ignored that Apple Records is a division of Apple Corps Ltd., leading to an erroneous intermediate conclusion about the parent company.
